info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Beverage Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of beverage recliner details within the catalog. It allows users to create comprehensive entries that define the attributes of various beverage recliners, enhancing the catalog's richness and usability. Typical consumers include product managers and catalog administrators who need to update and maintain product information. By utilizing this API, businesses can ensure that their beverage recliner offerings are accurately represented and easily accessible for end-users.

post.summary: Create details for a beverage recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and submit detailed information for a specific beverage recliner, enabling effective tracking and management of its features and options.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the details for a beverage recliner operation. The information supplied will be processed to manage or update the recliner's attributes as required.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the details have been returned.
